sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I'm feeling great about the opportunities ahead for Apple.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: From our product roadmap and broad range of services to promising areas like health, emerging markets, enterprise, and education.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As one example, we recently secured our biggest education deal ever for Mac with

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: the Department of Education in the Philippines.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: They're going to deploy 170,000 MacBook Neos to teachers and staff.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Opportunities like this bring more users into our ecosystem and help fuel growth across our business.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Apple is the greatest company in the world.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We've assembled an extraordinary collection of talent.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The best engineers, designers, developers, and experts in every corner of our business.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: From our supply chain to our stores.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Every day we bring the right people together with the best ideas to build products and services that change lives.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Guided by a foundational set of values and a belief that the best technology should

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: make a better world.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We do that by making products that are powerful and intuitive and meet Apple's uncompromising standards for quality, performance, design, and durability.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: That's the Apple experience customers love.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And with our latest lineup, people have even more reasons than ever to upgrade or switch to an Apple product.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: At the same time, Apple services amplify the experience of every device.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Helping people work, play, listen, watch, and stay connected to the world around them.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I'm delighted with where our services business is today and where it's going.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And with an installed base of more than 2.5 billion active devices, I'm looking

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: forward to expanding our offerings and improving the lives of users around the world.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We see tremendous opportunity in AI as well.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Siri AI marks a new chapter in AI at Apple.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: It is a completely reimagined assistant that is powerful, personal, private, and deeply relevant to our users' daily lives.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Siri AI picks up what's relevant to our users, understands what's on their screen, and holds a natural conversation.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: All to help them with the things they do every day.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: It's the Siri we've always wanted.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We are very pleased with the reviews and feedback we've received, and we're so excited that more and more users are getting to experience it.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: iPhone remains at the center of our opportunity as the intelligent personal hub.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: It's always with you and understands your personal context.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: From your messages to your photos, notes, and apps, to deliver powerful intelligence right when you need it.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Then there's Mac, which is having an AI moment all its own.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Mac is what brought me to Apple, and through the years it has opened a world of possibilities.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: More than 40 years after the first Mac, the category is having its biggest moment yet, with every Mac in our latest lineup a powerful platform for AI.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Mac Mini and Mac Studio in particular are pushing the boundaries of local,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: private AI, giving users the ability to do things once considered impossible.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: From Mac to iPhone to iPad, we are proud that our products are the best platforms in the industry for AI for both first party and third party applications.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And we're excited about the opportunities that creates.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Ultimately, everything we do at Apple is for our users.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The success of every innovation is best measured by its impact on people's lives.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And that's what drives us to keep building great products and to get them into the hands of people all around the world.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now let's take a deeper dive into our results for the quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier, we had an excellent quarter at Apple.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In addition to September quarter and fiscal year records in total company revenue, iPhone set a September quarter revenue record, capping its best fiscal year ever.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Services achieved an all time record during the quarter to close out our best year ever there too.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We grew in the vast majority of markets we track, setting September quarter records in the Americas, Europe, Greater China, and the rest of Asia Pacific.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also set September quarter revenue records in both developed and emerging markets, in addition to an all time record in India.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to our lineup, iPhone revenue was $57.6 billion for the September quarter, up 17% from a year ago,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: despite supply constraints and foreign exchange headwinds.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We grew strong double digits in the US and Greater China to achieve September quarter revenue records.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also set a September quarter record for upgraders worldwide as well as in the US, China, mainland, and India.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Helping to deliver our best fiscal year ever for upgraders globally.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: At the launch in September, we introduced the all new iPhone Duo.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: From the very beginning, we knew what we wanted to create.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A foldable form factor with a larger display that feels as natural and intuitive as iPad.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We designed the hardware and software together to make it unmistakably iPhone,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: while enabling entirely new ways to use it.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The result is a series of remarkable innovations that we believe will redefine what a foldable phone can be.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We're so proud of what our teams have built.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Developers have been quickly adapting to this new form factor, and we're excited to see more and more apps optimized for iPhone Duo.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We've been thrilled with the early response from reviewers and customers, and we are working hard to get iPhone Duo into customers' hands as quickly as we can.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We have also been thrilled with the response to iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: It's easy to see why customers are embracing them.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our latest models feature a dramatically improved camera system with

sentences.speaker: Management

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: breakthrough upgrades like variable aperture and all new photographic styles.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The A20 Pro and next generation Vapor Chamber together deliver the highest sustained performance in iPhone history.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: An iPhone 18 Pro Max delivers the biggest increase in battery life ever on an iPhone.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A20 Pro also features a new dual 16 core neural engine accelerating on device AI and computational photography.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to Mac, revenue was $10.8 billion, up 24% from a year ago despite supply constraints.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We had double digit growth in the majority of markets we track, and particularly strong performance in our emerging markets,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: where we set a September quarter revenue record.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also set a September quarter record for customers new to the Mac.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: According to IDC, we gained share globally during the quarter and for the full fiscal year, and we have never sold more Macs in a fiscal year than we did this time, which is a truly remarkable testament to these incredible products.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Last week, we introduced a whole new way for people to experience Mac.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The all new MacBook Pro with Proled XDR brings touch to the Mac for the first time.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: It also boasts the best Pro laptop display we have ever shipped, plus all day battery and our most immersive laptop audio.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And it all comes together in a thinner and lighter design.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also brought the power of M6 to the new 14 inch MacBook Pro and the new iMac.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This latest generation of Apple Silicon includes the world's fastest CPU core to speed up everyday tasks, in addition to a dual 16 core neural engine to drive private on device AI tasks.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now turning to iPad, where revenue was $6.2 billion for the September quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Last week, we introduced the all new iPad Mini with an amazing new OLED display, super thin design and the power of A20 Pro.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With the newest edition, our iPad lineup is more capable and versatile than ever before.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Anywhere our users go, there's a place for iPad.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Like a classroom, where it helps students explore the world in amazing ways, or a design studio, giving artists and creatives an expansive canvas to explore their ideas.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In wearables, home and accessories, revenue was $8.3 billion for the September quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Apple Watch makes the simple act of wearing a watch a powerful way to help take care of your health.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We were thrilled to introduce our all new health sensing system to help our users get the most out of health tracking.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And compared with the S11 chip, Apple's most powerful wearable chip, the health sensing system delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We were also happy to unveil new features like health age and readiness,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: which will tell you when to push forward or hold back, as well as the all new health app redesign.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And we're excited for audio intelligence, which will be coming in a future software update and will help you remember moments you might otherwise miss.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Apple Watch Series 12 brings it all together in a beautifully light design, while Apple Watch Ultra 4 goes further with longer battery life compared to the previous generation and the most accurate on device GPS in a sports watch.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Meanwhile, AirPods 5 offers best in class open ear active noise cancellation at an incredible price, while improving sound quality, battery life and durability.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With iPhone and Apple intelligence, including Siri AI,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: AirPods allow users to do remarkable things, like connect with someone who's speaking another language with live translation, or get answers with broad world knowledge entirely hands free.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And just a few weeks ago, we introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The iPhone Active install base grew to an all time high, and iPhone had a record year for up-graders globally and in several markets, including the US, China Mainland, India, and Japan.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: According to a recent survey from World Panel, iPhone was a top-selling model

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: in the US, urban China, India, the UK, Germany, Australia, and Japan.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Mac revenue was $10.8 billion, up 24% year over year, despite supply constraints.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This performance was driven by the strength of the MacBook Neo and MacBook Pro.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We saw a double digit growth in both developed and emerging markets, with all time records in markets like India and Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Emerging markets continued to see strong performance on Mac, resulting in Mac's best fiscal year there, driven by record up-graders and customers new to the Mac.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: iPad revenue was $6.2 billion, down 10% year over year, driven by the supply constraints I mentioned earlier, as well as a continued difficult compare against the launch of the A16 powered iPad in the prior year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The iPad install base reached an all-time high during the quarter, and over half of the customers who purchased an iPad were new to the product.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Wearables home and accessories revenue was $8.3 billion, down 8% year over year, as we face a difficult compare against the launch of the Watch SE 3 and the AirPods Pro 3 in the prior year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The Wearables install base reached a new all-time high in over half of

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: customers who bought an Apple Watch in the quarter were new to the product.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Services revenue set an all-time record of $31.6 billion, up 10% year over year, despite over one and a half points of sequential FX headwinds.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We set all-time revenue records in the majority of markets we track, including several emerging markets like Latin America and India.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We are optimistic about the long-term future of our services business.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With our large install base of over two and a half billion active devices, we have an incredibly strong foundation for growth opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our services continue to attract more customers, and both transacting and

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: paid accounts reached new all-time highs in the quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also have over one and a half billion paid subscriptions, which grew double digits during the quarter, reaching an all-time high.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And we continue to improve and expand our services offerings from iCloud Plus plans that now include Apple TV and Apple Arcade in more than a hundred countries and regions to ads and Apple Maps, now live in the U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: and Canada, which will give local businesses a new way to reach customers while respecting our users' privacy.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning now to enterprise, organizations are continuing to expand their fleets of Apple devices to transform operations and drive productivity.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Duke Health performed the first surgical procedure using Apple Vision Pro for hip arthroscopy with an FDA authorized app from Striker.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: American Airlines is deploying over 37,000 iPhone 17 devices to flight attendants for in-flight purchases with tap to pay, in addition to 25,000 iPads for pilots and mechanics.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And more companies are choosing Mac across a growing range of use cases, including for on-device AI.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: For example, Gap Inc. is running AI entirely on Mac Mini for loss prevention across hundreds of stores, eliminating cloud token costs.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Christie's, a world-leading auction house, is running local models on Mac Studio to improve core productivity workflows such as pricing estimates.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Let's turn to our cash position and capital return program.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We ended the quarter with $137 billion in cash and marketable securities and $80 billion in total debt.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: During the quarter, we returned $28 billion to shareholders.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This included $3.9 billion in dividends and equivalents and $24 billion in share repurchases.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As we move ahead into the December quarter, I'd like to review our outlook, which includes the types of forward-looking information that Suhasthi referred to.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Importantly, the color we're providing assumes that global tariff rates, policies, and their application remain in effect as of this call, and the global macroeconomic outlook does not worsen from today.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect our December quarter total company revenue to grow between 7 and 10% year over year, which reflects our best view of constrained supply.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect this to be the best quarter for revenue in the history of the company.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect services revenue to grow between 8 and 9% year over year in the December quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This contemplates sequential headwinds, primarily driven by third-party licensing and foreign exchange.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect gross margin to be between 45% and 46%.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This includes primarily the impact of higher memory costs, as well as some costs related to the ramp of Siri AI.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect operating expenses to be between $20.4 billion and $20.8 billion.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect OI&E to be around $300 million, excluding any potential impact from the mark to market of minority investments, and our tax rate to be around 17%.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Finally, today, our board of directors has declared a cash dividend of 27 cents per share of the company's total revenue.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With that, I'll hand it back to John.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Thanks, Kevin.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Before we get into questions, I'd like to introduce Sabi Khan, Apple's chief operating officer.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Many of you know Sabi from his work with worldwide operations and supply chain, leading many important functions at Apple, including manufacturing, AppleCare, environmental efforts, and supplier partnerships around the world.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Sabi and his team are the reason we're able to build and deliver products at a scale and of a caliber unlike anyone else out there.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I've asked Sabi to join Kevin and me on these calls as we take your questions.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Thank you, John.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We ask that you limit yourself to two questions.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Operator, may we have the first question, please?

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Our first question is from Michael Inc. of Goldman Sachs.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Please go ahead.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Hey, good afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Thank you for the questions.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: I have two.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: First, on the iPhone 18, the standard model was left out of the September lineup.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: I was just wondering if you could share some of the reasons why, whether there were some supply constraints and component-related things that led to that decision, or if it had to do with the launch of the Duo.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Any call there would be helpful, and then I have a follow-up.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Yeah, thanks, Michael.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Look, we were thrilled to introduce the iPhone Duo and 18 Pro earlier this year in September.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And we have iPhone 17, iPhone Air, and 17E continuing to kind of round out this incredibly strong lineup for the holidays.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: So obviously we don't make any comments about future roadmap, but we're excited about where we're at.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Great. Thank you.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: And then my second question is just around iCloud+.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: It seems like it's becoming a more strategic product, just given the tie-in with home security, as well as the potential monetization opportunity for Apple intelligence.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: So I was just wondering, what are you seeing on iCloud+, are there any tailwinds in terms of attach rates, just particularly given the rising cost for increased storage options on iPhone, and the company's push into home products?

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Yeah, thanks for the question.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I think we just, in the September quarter, had an all-time record for our cloud services for revenue.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And you mentioned iCloud+. This is something we're very excited about.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We have these iCloud+, plans that now include Apple TV and Apple Arcade in more than 100 countries and regions where we think we can really reach new potential subscribers.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And then as you mentioned, we think there's good opportunities on Apple intelligence.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: There's going to be some usage limits on features that rely on server-side models, which include Siri AI and intelligent photo editing, some other things like that.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And so anyone who needs greater capacity will be able to purchase expanded access in the future.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: So, and it's your point, in the beginning, iCloud tiers were largely about storage,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: but we've been adding more capabilities and features to it.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Thank you so much, John.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Awesome. Thank you, Mike.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Operator, could we get the next question, please?

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Our next question is from Eric Woodring from Morgan Stanley. Please go ahead.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Hey, guys. Thank you for taking my questions, and John, congrats on your first quarter here.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: So as the world of AI evolves from chatbots to consumer agents, it seems like there are growing opportunities for Apple. It also seems like there are risks.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: And John, I'd just love to get your perspective on what role you want Apple and Siri AI to play in kind of this consumer-agentic AI landscape and just how you look at any potential risks of some of these agents trying to encroach on your services business.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Thank you, Rob. I'll start with the quarterly results for immunology, which delivered total revenues approaching $9.2 billion, reflecting operational sales growth of 16.6%.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Skyrizzy and RINVO continue to exceed our expectations, demonstrating robust growth across all indications. Skyrizzy total sales were nearly $5.8 billion, up 22.9% on an operational basis. In psoriasis, Skyrizzy prescription trends remain very strong. Recent oral competition is not having as substantial an impact on the overall health of our patients as it did in the past.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We believe that Skyrizzy's best-in-class profile, which delivers 100% skin clearance for the majority of psoriasis patients, high durability of response, very convenient quarterly dosing, exceptional long-term safety, and robust joint protection in psoriatic arthritis with strong data through five years of treatment.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This is a very high bar relative to other therapies on the market or in development for psoriasis.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We further strengthened our leadership position in inflammatory bowel disease with the FDA approval of Skyrizzy subcutaneous induction in Crohn's disease, which was based on the Phase III AFFIRM study.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Detailed results from this trial were presented at the recent ACG and UEG meetings, demonstrating exceptional results across all clinical and endoscopic measures.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We are extremely pleased with Skyrizzy's strong performance, particularly in patients who had not previously experienced advanced therapy.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In this patient segment, unprecedented results were observed after just 16 weeks of therapy, with 60% endoscopic response, 43% endoscopic remission, and 74% for clinical remission.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: These results highlight the potential of subcutaneous induction

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: to further enhance Skyrizzy's position in earlier lines of Crohn's disease.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Additionally, the Skyrizzy label was updated to provide healthcare providers greater discretion in determining whether tuberculosis evaluation is appropriate prior to treatment initiation, rather than requiring mandatory subcutaneous TB evaluation for all patients.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Also at the UEG conference, results were presented from the Phase II target CD study evaluating Skyrizzy plus our novel anti-alpha-4-beta-7 antibody, ABBV382, in Crohn's disease.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The combination resulted in a near doubling of endoscopic remission at week 24 compared to either monotherapy.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Additionally, gut gene expression was improved, and gut gene expression data showed a clear improvement from active disease at baseline to early intestinal healing at week 12, followed by broader tissue restoration at week 24.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Early changes reflected repair of the intestinal lining and restoration of the gut barrier, effects not observed with monotherapy.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: By week 24, these changes evolved into signatures associated with tissue repair, nerve recovery, and normalization of metabolic function.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We believe this progression from inflammation to healing, and ultimately tissue restoration, may represent an important step toward modifying the underlying disease, rather than simply controlling symptoms.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: These results support our strategy of combining Skyrizzy with complementary mechanisms to achieve meaningfully higher levels of efficacy in IBD.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A large multi-arm phase 2b trial is underway evaluating Skyrizzy plus 382 and Skyrizzy plus 701, an extended half-life anti-TL1a antibody, in both Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In parallel, co-formulation work is ongoing in preparation for phase 3 trials.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Moving to dermatology, positive top-line results were recently announced from a phase 3 study evaluating ludicizumab in Hidradenitis suppurativa.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: At week 16, ludicizumab demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements across multiple measures of disease activity.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: High score 75, which is a rigorous bar for defining clinical response, was achieved by 31% of ludicizumab patients.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Ludicizumab also significantly improved skin pain,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: BCMA-directed bispecifics and CAR-T therapies have transformed multiple myeloma treatment.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: However, their adoption, particularly among community-based centers, remains limited by adverse events such as CRS, neurotoxicity, and serious infections, as well as the need for specialized monitoring.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With a differentiated safety profile, simplified onboarding, and a more convenient once-monthly dosing schedule after a single step-up dose, Atentimig has the potential to streamline treatment and expand access across settings, including community-based clinics.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A regulatory application was recently submitted to the FDA, with an approval decision anticipated next year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Beyond the Cervino program, two new phase 3 trials were recently initiated for Atentimig, one in combination with pomalidomide in second-line plus multiple myeloma, and another as a monotherapy in patients with newly diagnosed,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: light-chain amyloidosis.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And at the upcoming ASH meeting, early results from a phase 2 study evaluating Atentimig plus daratumumab in frail, transplant-ineligible front-line multiple myeloma will be presented, with a third phase 3 study potentially starting next year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Continuing with other HEMONC programs, positive top-line results were announced from the phase 3 core DLBCL2 trial evaluating Epkinley in combination with RCHOP in front-line DLBCL.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The study demonstrated a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: compared to RCHOP alone.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Epkinley plus RCHOP showed an overwhelming treatment benefit at this interim analysis, reducing the risk of disease progression or death by 51% in a broad population covering patients with international prognostic index scores between 2 and 5.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Importantly, this is the first phase 3 study with a bispecific antibody combination to demonstrate a progression-free survival benefit in front-line DLBCL2.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Supporting the potential for Epkinley plus RCHOP to become a new standard of care in this setting, regulatory submissions are anticipated early next year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to solid tumors, at the World Conference on Lung Cancer, results from a phase 1 study evaluating our PD-1 VEGF bispecific antibody, ABBV1480, in front-line non-small cell lung cancer were presented.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: These early data were particularly encouraging given the activity observed in PD-L1 negative patients, a group which has traditionally been more difficult to treat.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A phase 3 study was recently initiated to evaluate the ADC in combination with chemotherapy in front-line squamous and non-squamous small cell lung cancer.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also intend to move quickly to evaluate 1480 in combination with our ADCs across several tumor types.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Two phase 2 studies evaluating 1480 plus TMAB-A were recently initiated, one in non-small cell lung cancer and another in colorectal cancer.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And a phase 2 combination study with ABBV706, our SES6 ADC, will begin next year in small cell lung cancer.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Moving to obesity, detailed results were presented at EASD from a phase 1 multiple ascending dose study evaluating ABBV295

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: in adults with a mean BMI of less than 30.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We continue to be encouraged by the emerging profile for this long-acting amylin amyloid.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In the study, 295 demonstrated meaningful weight loss across multiple dosing regimens, a manageable tolerability profile, and a PK profile that supports potentially differentiating dosing intervals of every other week or monthly.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A phase 1B study in obese patients is ongoing with interim data anticipated around the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Additionally, a phase 2 trial in obese patients was recently initiated.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to aesthetics,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: we continue to work closely with the FDA to resolve outstanding matters related to the complete response letter for BOE.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Resubmission to the FDA is anticipated before the end of this year, with a regulatory decision expected in mid-2027.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Additionally, we are exploring a combination of Botox with BOE, which has the potential to deliver differentiated efficacy by combining the rapid onset of BOE with the durable effects of Botox.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A phase 2 study recently began to evaluate this combination in glabellar lines.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In summary, we continue to make meaningful progress

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: across all stages and therapeutic areas of our pipeline and look forward to several more important pipeline milestones during the remainder of this year and into 2027.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With that, I'll turn the call over to Scott.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Thank you, Rupal.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Starting with our third quarter results, we reported adjusted earnings per share of $3.82, which is 7 cents above our guidance midpoint.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: These results include an 11-cent unfavorable impact from acquired IPR&D expense.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: What was once predominantly viewed as a healthcare market, almost exclusively shaped by healthcare professionals, has increasingly become a market shape by changing consumer preferences, wellness trends, and retail execution.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: While this market evolution is not inherently positive or negative, it has fundamentally changed the environment in which we operate.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: So to best position our nutrition business for maximum long-term success, we must evolve and adapt accordingly.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: At the same time, Abbott has strategically repositioned its portfolio over the past decade into attractive, high-growth markets that require sustained investment to drive innovation and support long-term growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: So we believe both businesses will be better positioned for the future as independent organizations, each with a distinct identity, reflecting their different customer bases, growth profiles, investment requirements, and innovation cycles.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This separation will enable both companies to sharpen strategic and operational focus, direct resources more effectively,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: and enhance commercial and R&D effectiveness.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As an independent company, nutrition will be uniquely positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for healthy nutrition, as consumers increasingly recognize the importance of metabolic health and the role healthy nutrition plays in disease prevention and overall wellness.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The new nutrition company will be created from a position of strength.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The team has done an exceptional job building a balanced growth model supported by sustainable mix, a volume, and price.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The portfolio includes several iconic brands, including Similac, PediaSure, Ensure, Glucerna, and Pedialyte, which have market-leading positions across the pediatric and adult nutrition categories.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With approximately $8.5 billion in annual sales, 16,000 employees, and 14 manufacturing sites, this will be the largest globally scaled pure-play company in the healthy nutrition market.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Given its scale and financial profile, we would expect this new company to qualify for inclusion in the S&P 500.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And pleased to share that Daniel Salvadore, Executive Vice President and Group President of Established Pharmaceuticals and Nutrition Products, will become Chief Executive Officer of the new nutrition company.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Daniel joined Abbott in 2014 as Senior Vice President in our Established Pharmaceuticals business for Latin America and also served as Executive Vice President of Nutrition Products

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: for four years before being appointed to his current position in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Throughout his career at Abbott, Daniel has demonstrated outstanding strategic insight and operational excellence.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: His broad international experience and proven track record of delivering results as a business operator make him exceptionally well suited for this role and I'm confident he will be a tremendous success.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Daniel will be joined by an experienced leadership team with deep industry experience.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And this is a battle-tested team that has demonstrated exceptional resilience and dedication while navigating a dynamic and evolving operating environment.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Following the separation, Abbott will remain one of the largest, most diversified, and fastest growing healthcare companies in the world.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The Abbott portfolio will consist of an even stronger mix of higher growth, higher margin businesses powered by technology and innovation.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As a result, we expect Abbott sales growth to accelerate and margin profiles to expand.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: While the Abbott portfolio will evolve.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And maintaining balance across products, payers and geographies will remain a key strength and source of resilience for the company.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We built this portfolio to hold market leading positions in three of the most attractive areas of healthcare, medtech, diagnostics and established pharmaceuticals.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The portfolio was also intentionally built to align with durable healthcare trends, including an aging population, increasing prevalence of chronic disease, and a growing demand for

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: earlier diagnosis.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: and more personalized treatment.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With market-leading positions, an industry-leading pipeline, and a proven ability to consistently generate strong earnings growth and cash flow, Abbott is exceptionally well-positioned to deliver sustainable growth and create long-term shareholder value in the years ahead.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I cannot be more excited about this future.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I have tremendous confidence in Abbott's future as an innovation-driven healthcare company, and I'm also confident in the opportunities that lie ahead for the new nutrition company.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Most importantly, this creates two stronger organizations that will both continue to fulfill our mission of helping people live better lives.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We look forward to sharing updates on our progress as we move through the separation process.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I'll now review the third quarter results before I turn the call over to Phil.

sentences.text: Sales grew 7% in the third quarter, and earnings per share grew 9%, representing an acceleration.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We saw a significant increase in growth on both top and bottom lines compared to our results in the first half of the year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to diagnostics, where sales grew 6.5%, driven by performance in our core laboratory and cancer diagnostic businesses.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Core lab sales grew 5.5%, driven by strong performance in the U.S., Europe, Japan, and Latin America.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: On our earnings call in July, I highlighted that test volume data sourced directly

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: from thousands of instruments located across the U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: and around the world, showed a pattern of strong and stable demand.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We view this as a positive indicator of the underlying demand for healthcare more broadly.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: During the third quarter, our testing data continued to support that view, with testing demand remaining healthy and at durable levels.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In cancer diagnostics, sales growth of 14% was driven by Cologuard and contributions to growth from our precision oncology and international businesses.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We saw a significant increase in growth on both top and bottom lines compared to our results in the first half of the year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to diagnostics, where sales grew 6.5%, driven by performance in our core laboratory and cancer diagnostic businesses.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Core lab sales grew 5.5%, driven by strong performance in the U.S., Europe, Japan, and Latin America.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: On our earnings call in July, I highlighted that test volume data sourced directly

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: from thousands of instruments located across the U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: and around the world, showed a pattern of strong and stable demand.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We view this as a positive indicator of the underlying demand for healthcare more broadly.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: During the third quarter, our testing data continued to support that view, with testing demand remaining healthy and at durable levels.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In cancer diagnostics, sales growth of 14% was driven by Cologuard and contributions to growth from our precision oncology and international businesses.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In September, we launched our first blood-based colorectal cancer screening test.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As the only company to offer both stool-based and blood-based screening options,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: we are expanding the options available to healthcare providers and patients to help achieve the goal of getting more people screened.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to nutrition, sales grew 5%, reflecting broad-based growth across all four categories, U.S. pediatric, international pediatric, U.S. adult, and international adult.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As I mentioned, the team has done an exceptional job executing a more balanced growth strategy, achieving a more sustainable mix of volume and price-driven growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In pediatric nutrition, sales grew 9%, led by growth of 11% in the U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As I noted last quarter, the strong performance in the U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: includes the benefit from WIC contract wins secured earlier this year,

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: which helped Abbott regain its market leadership position in both the WIC and non-WIC segments.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In adult nutrition, sales increased 2%, driven by growth of 3.5% in the U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: as retail consumption data continues to trend in a positive direction.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also continue to live strong growth on a sequential basis, with worldwide nutrition sales increasing more than $100 million compared to the second quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And finally, we continue to make good progress advancing our innovation pipeline.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: During the quarter, we launched a new version of our Similac infant formula made with whole milk.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This new product is the first and only commercially sterile, ready-to-feed liquid infant formula made with whole milk available in the United States.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to EPD, where sales increased 8.5% in the quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our broad portfolio of prescription and over-the-counter medicines, tailored to address local healthcare needs, continues to drive strong growth across emerging markets.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Growth in the quarter was broad-based across geographies and therapeutic areas, and this included double-digit growth in several countries across Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East, highlighting the strong and durable demand that has long been a hallmark of this business.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And I'll wrap up with medical devices, where sales grew 8%.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Growth was well-balanced across the portfolio, led by double-digit growth in electrophysiology and rhythm management.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In electrophysiology, our third quarter results reflected the growth of the medical devices.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Growth in the quarter was mid-teens or high-teens when excluding LAA.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In the U.S., high-teens and exceeded 20% excluding LAA.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This performance was driven by increasing adoption of our new Volt PFA catheter, with momentum accelerating in September, following the transition to a full U.S. market release in mid-August.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: International growth also accelerated.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As we continue to capture market share in Europe, driven by increasing uptake of our new PFA catheters and growth in other categories across our broad portfolio.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In September, we received FDA approval earlier than expected for our TactiFlex Duo catheter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This catheter enables physicians to seamlessly switch between using RF and PFA energy during a procedure.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Given physicians' familiarity with the TactiFlex platform, we expect to execute a broad U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: launch starting in the fourth quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In the third quarter, we also received CE mark for our new AMOLED 360 left atrial appendage device, designed to help reduce the risk of stroke in patients with AFib.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We look forward to bringing this new technology to the U.S.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Sales grew 10%, driven by increased adoption of AVERA across both single and dual chamber segments of the pacemaker market.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This expanding use of AVERA is occurring in both the U.S. and international markets.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In diabetes care, continuous glucose monitoring sales grew 8% in the quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In August, we received FDA approval for LibreDuo, the world's first dual glucose ketone bio-variable sensor.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This marks the first time that people with diabetes will be able to monitor ketones without the need for traditional blood or urine tests.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect to launch this new sensor in the U.S. in December.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: So, in summary, we delivered an acceleration in growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: On both top and bottom lines, innovation continues to be a key differentiator for Abbott, highlighted by multiple new product approvals and launches that further strengthen our ability to deliver sustainable growth in the years ahead.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And we took an important strategic step towards shaping our future through the planned creation of a new market-leading nutrition company.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I'll now turn it over to call to Phil.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Let me begin my remarks with an overview of some of the key aspects of our planning process for the separation.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The first is the separation.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The new nutrition company will become a through a planned, tax-free distribution to Abbott shareholders.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Upon completion of the separation, Abbott shareholders will own shares of both Abbott and the new nutrition company, enabling our shareholders to participate in the value creation opportunities of both businesses.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The final share distribution ratio will be communicated prior to the separation, which we anticipate completing by the end of next year, subject to the required approval.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We incur separation-related costs as we progress through the separation process.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: These costs will be treated as specified items and excluded from adjusted earnings.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As a result, we do not expect the separation to have an impact on our supply in January.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We will establish capital structures that ensure both companies have a strong financial foundation.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This includes ensuring adequate capital to support long-term growth objectives and capital allocation priorities, while maintaining strong investment-grade credit ratings for both companies.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As part of that process, we are planning for the new company to raise debt.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With a portion of the project to be completed by the end of next year, we will be able to provide a new financial foundation for Abbott.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect a portion of the proceeds to be distributed to Abbott.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The amount of debt to be raised and the amount to be distributed to Abbott will be determined at a later date.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect that both Abbott and the new nutrition company will pay a dividend that, when combined, will equal Abbott's dividend at the time of the separation.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Following the separation, we expect Abbott's financial profile to reflect an acceleration in the sales growth and increased profitability.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: For the current profile of the nutrition business from the current profile of the Abbott portfolio, we would expect sales growth to accelerate.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect the new business to be able to increase sales by 50 to 100 basis points, gross margin as a percent of sales to increase by more than 200 basis points, and an operating margin as a percent of sales to increase by approximately 100 basis points.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: On a comparable basis, an adjusted earnings per share of $1.42 was in line with our guidance and the consensus estimate.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Foreign exchange had an unfavorable year-over-year impact of 0.4% on third-quarter sales, which was a slight improvement compared to our expectations at the time of our earnings call in July.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Regarding other aspects of the P&L, the adjusted gross margin profile was 57.2% of sales, representing an increase of 140 basis points compared to the prior year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The improvement in gross margin was broad-based, reflecting favorable business mix within the legacy Abbott portfolio and from the addition of Exact Sciences, as well as the continued operational improvements and disciplined execution of our margin expansion initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The adjusted R&D was 6.9% of sales.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And adjusted SG&A was 26.9% of sales.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And based on current rates, we expect exchange to have a negative impact of approximately 1% on fourth-quarters.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Good morning everyone, and welcome to Caterpillar's third quarter of 2026 Earnings call.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I'm Alex Kapper, Vice President of Investor Relations.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Joining me today are Joe Creed, Chairman and CEO, Kyle Epley, Chief Financial Officer, Stephanie Boffman, Senior Vice President of the Global Finance Services Division, and Ryan Coleman, Senior Director of IR.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: During our call, we'll be discussing third quarter earnings release we issued earlier You can find our slides, the news release, and a webcast recap at investors.caterpillar.com under events and presentations.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Moving to slide two.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: During our call today, we'll make forward-looking statements which are subject to risks and uncertainties.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We'll also make assumptions that could cause our actual results to be different than the information we're sharing with you on this call.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Please refer to our recent SEC filings and the forward-looking statements reminder and the news release for details on factors that individually or in aggregate could cause our actual results to vary materially from our forecast.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: A detailed discussion of the many factors that we believe may have a material effect on our business on an ongoing basis is contained in our SEC filings.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: On today's call, we'll also refer to non-GAAP numbers.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: For any reconciliation of any non-GAAP numbers to the appropriate U.S. GAAP numbers, please see the appendix of the earnings call slides.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: For today's agenda, Joe will begin by sharing his perspectives about our results, and he'll highlight key initiatives across our segments.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Then he'll discuss our full year outlook and insights about our end markets.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Kyle will provide a detailed overview of results and share key assumptions looking forward.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We'll conclude by taking your questions.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now let's advance to slide three and turn the call over to Joe Creed.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Good morning and thanks Alex.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: I appreciate everyone joining us today.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our third quarter results reflect the durability of our end markets

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: with our highest sales quarter ever, strong order rates, and a record backlog.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our team continues to execute our strategic priorities in a dynamic environment, positioning us for a strong year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Sales and revenues were $20.7 billion, up 17% versus the prior year, driven by strong end market demand.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We delivered adjusted profit per share of $7.20, an increase of 45% versus last year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Strong order rates across all three of our primary segments drove backlog to a record $78 billion.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: That's an increase of approximately $38 billion, or 96% from the third quarter last year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And marks the fourth consecutive quarter of sequential backlog growth in all three

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: of our primary segments.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The quarter demonstrated the team's ability to execute in a high growth environment.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Specifically, our power and energy team continued to increase production of large reciprocating engines and turbines while simultaneously expanding capacity to meet demand.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The team is effectively managing the operational challenges that come with this rapid growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Bringing additional capacity online is still the top pacing factor for growth and power and energy.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: So working diligently to execute our plans and meet our customers' needs.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As I mentioned, sales and revenues were $20.7 billion, and they were in line with our expectations.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The increase from the prior year was primarily driven by strong growth in sales volume

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: and favorable price realization in all three of our primary segments.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Third quarter adjusted operating profit margin was 20.6%.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Excluding IEPA tariff recoveries, adjusted operating profit margin was in line with our expectations.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In the third quarter, we generated MP&E free cash flow of $3.8 billion and deployed $2 billion to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now I'll review third quarter retail statistics.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In power and energy, sales to users were $2.8 billion.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In power and energy, sales to users grew a robust 36%.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Power generation grew 75%, driven by continued very strong demand for turbines and large reciprocating engines used in data center applications.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Sales to users in oil and gas increased 5% and were driven by turbines and turbine-related services.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Industrial sales to users were down due to softness in the EME region.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now for construction industries.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We have one of the broadest ranges of products, technology, and services to support customers whether they prefer to own lease or rent equipment.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Combined with healthy construction activity, our unique position has allowed us to outpace the industry throughout the year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In the third quarter, total sales to users increased 20%, marking the seventh

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: consecutive quarter of year-over-year growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In North America, sales to users grew a robust 27% in line with expectations.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Dealer rental revenue in North America continued to grow, driving increased investment in their equipment fleets.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also saw strong customer interest in the CAT dealer-owned rental joint venture called Major Projects, which was launched last quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As a reminder, Major Projects will serve customers developing large-scale infrastructure across North America, including transportation, energy, manufacturing, and data center builds.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: It's a supplemental national rental solution to help deliver larger size-class

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: construction equipment and capabilities where existing individual dealer rental fleets aren't sufficient to execute at scale.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As a result, rental fleet loading was exceptionally strong in the third quarter, contributing significantly to sales to users' growth compared with prior year when fleet loading was a slight headwind.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Even excluding the positive impact from the rental fleet loading, sales to users' growth was strong, driven by residential and non-residential construction activity.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Sales to users in Iami were above expectations, with growth driven by strength in Europe and Africa, partially offset by softness in the Middle East.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In Asia Pacific, sales to users outside of China were lower than we anticipated and declined slightly due to timing.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: China, however, continued to grow from a low base as we expected.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Latin America continued to grow but at a lower rate than we anticipated.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: For resource industries, third quarter sales to users increased 4%, which is below our expectations.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Sales to users were higher in heavy construction and quarry and aggregates, but lower in mining due to delays in shipping and commissioning.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The rail decrease was driven by lower international locomotive deliveries.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Turning to slide four, I'll cover a few highlights since our last earnings call, starting with power and energy.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We serve customers across the power and energy value chain, and demand for our solutions remains strong.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: To ensure we can meet their needs and maintain operational excellence, we're continually evaluating opportunities to repurpose underutilized facilities across our footprint.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In line with that approach, we plan to use a portion of our Winston-Salem North Carolina facility, which currently produces locomotive engines, as a second assembly and test location for the 3,600 series of the North Carolina Reciprocating Engine.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The footprint will support our oil and gas customers to meet the growing need for natural gas compression.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The initiative directly supports previously announced plans to increase

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: large reciprocating engine capacity to nearly three times the 2024 level by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Utilizing our existing footprint and workforce is the most cost-effective and quickest way for us to bring additional capacity online.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In construction industries, we launched CAT Compact, which is a key part of our strategy to reach more small contractors in the growing compact construction equipment industry.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: To support that growth and meet increasing customer demand, we announced a $1 billion investment to expand manufacturing capacity in Sanford, North Carolina.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The investment will create a modern technology-enabled manufacturing environment designed to improve safety, quality, and operational

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: performance while supporting long-term growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The facility will incorporate advanced manufacturing technologies, automation, digital production systems, and integrated logistics capabilities to create a more connected and efficient operation.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This demonstrates how we're aligning our investments to meet our 2030 targets and positioning Caterpillar for long-term profitable growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And in resource industries, we announced last month that we're working with Luckstone to expand autonomous hauling technology across the country.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The expansion follows a highly successful pilot at the Bull Run Quarry, where autonomous trucks have hauled more than 3.5 million tons since going live in November of 2024.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: These deployments also mark the first use of Caterpillar's autonomous

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: technology on a CAT 775 truck, expanding our advanced autonomy capabilities beyond large mining applications and into quarry and aggregates.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: The next step is to expand our technology to the extent that we can, and into quarry and aggregates.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Through this customer collaboration, we gained insights that are helping us refine and scale our autonomous hauling solutions to deliver measurable value for operations at shop sites around the world.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: This expansion marks another important step towards our goal of tripling the number of CAT autonomous trucks by 2030 compared with 2024.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now on slide five, I'll provide an update on our outlook.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our strong execution through the first nine months positions us well to meet our full year outlook.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We continue to expect our full year 2026 sales and revenues to grow in the mid to high teens.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Strong order rates and a growing backlog reflect continued broad based momentum across our business, despite ongoing geopolitical uncertainty.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Excluding the favorable impact from IEPA tariff recoveries, we continue to expect full year adjusted operating profit margin to be near the bottom of the target range.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Also, as a reminder, our construction industry's fourth quarter margin typically has a sequential step down from the third quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We expect this seasonality change to be slightly more than our typical average step down due to the expected lower sales volume, higher SG&A and R&D related to our technology and digital investments, as well as higher freight costs.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: In resource industries, we anticipate a higher margin percentage compared to the prior year driven by favorable price

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: realization and a profit impact of higher sales volume, partially offset by unfavorable manufacturing costs including freight and material.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now on slide 16.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Let me provide a few comments on the full year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: As Joe mentioned, we continue to anticipate sales and revenues growth in the mid to high teens for the full year 2026.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our strong full year sales and revenues expectations is supported by strong sales to users growth across all three primary segments driven by healthy end markets, strong order rates across all three primary segments driving our backlog growth, increased output from

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: our capacity expansion plans which remain on schedule, and a strong year of services growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now for our adjusted operating profit margin for the full year.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Compared to last year, we expect a higher adjusted operating profit margin which reflects profit impact of higher sales and favorable price realization, partially offset by unfavorable manufacturing costs including spend related to our capacity expansion which includes higher depreciation expense as well as higher freight.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also expect higher SG&A and R&D.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Excluding IEPA tariff recoveries, our full year adjusted operating

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: profit margin is expected to be near the bottom of our target range.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Excluding our reported year to date IEPA tariff recoveries of about $520 million, we continue to expect full year 2026 tariff costs of around $2.2 billion.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our outlook does not include any additional IEPA tariff recoveries in the fourth quarter.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We now expect restructuring costs of about $300 million in 2026 which is on the low end of our prior range.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our estimated global annual effective tax rate remains approximately 23% for 2026, excluding discrete items.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We also continue to expect MP&E

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: free cash flow to be in the top half of our annual target range of $6 to $15 billion.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our capex spend for 2026 is now anticipated to be about $3.3 billion which is slightly below our prior expectations of $3.5 billion.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Now turning to slide 17 to summarize.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We delivered another very strong quarter with a year to date financial results tracking toward another record year for Caterpillar.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: Our end markets remain healthy with strong order rates and a growing backlog.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We continue to drive improved probability in a dynamic operating environment.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We will remain disciplined and committed to operational excellence and the O&E model.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We will continue to look for ways to invest efficiently.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: We will maintain a strong balance sheet and continue to return substantially all of our MP&E free cash flow to our shareholders through dividends and share repurchases over time.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: And finally, we will continue to execute our strategy for profitable growth.

sentences.speaker: Management
sentences.text: With that, we will take your question.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: We will now begin the question and answer session.

sentences.text: If you would like to ask a question, please press star one on your telephone keypad to raise your hand and enter the queue.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: If you would like to start your question, simply press star one again.

sentences.text: Please note we are only allowing one question per analyst.

sentences.text: Your first question comes from the line of Tammy Zaccaria from JP Morgan.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Your line is now open.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Ms. Zaccaria, your line is open.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: You may have your line on mute.

sentences.speaker: Operator
sentences.text: Hearing no response, we'll go next to Rob Wertheimer with Mellius Research.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Thanks and good morning.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: I had a couple questions around PowerGen.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Two quarters ago you detailed some of the Prime Power projects you've done and gave gigawatt numbers.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Do you have any update there?

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Is Prime Power still expanding for you, either in general, if you have any update on gigawatts?

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: And then you mentioned you're taking orders into 29.

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Does that imply that 28 is sold out?

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Are you selling out current capacity but leaving future capacity for future orders?

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Can you talk about how you manage backlog there?

sentences.speaker: Analyst
sentences.text: Thank you.
